messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up, onboarding gptx-mini-2026. We uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/gptx-mini/2026-03-14/model.tar.gz. Noticed the tokenizer behaves slightly differently from the other gptx family — there's an extra <|startoftext|> token being prepended in some chat templates. Need to confirm serving config and prompt templates before we flip traffic.

Mira Patel: Which tokenizer file are you using? HF tokenizer.json from the package or our internal normalized mapping?

Alex Chen: HF tokenizer from the model artifact (tokenizer.json + merges). In tokenizer.json special_tokens_map has 'bos_token': '<s>', 'eos_token': '</s>', and also 'startoftext': '<|startoftext|>'. But the vocab used during training didn't include <|startoftext|> as a separate id, so encode offsets are shifted.

Samir Gupta: Can you paste the first 20 ids from tokenizer.encode('Hello') so I can compare?

Alex Chen: Sure — quick snippet and observed output:

```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tk = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/tmp/gptx-mini-tokenizer')
print(tk.encode('Hello'))
# observed: [1, 234, 345, 2]
```

Jin Lee: Looks like 1 is BOS, 2 is EOS and the model config should match those ids. We should add a validation during onboarding that model.config.bos_token_id == tokenizer.bos_token_id (and same for eos/pad). Add CI lint to catch this.

Alex Chen: Agreed. Proposed minimal model config snippet to enforce: 

```json
{ "bos_token_id": 1, "eos_token_id": 2, "pad_token_id": 0 }
```

Mira Patel: Also spotted a chat-template delta: our chat wrapper currently prepends '<|startoftext|><s>' for multi-turn prompts which duplicates BOS. That leads to an extra empty token at the start on some requests. Quick mitigation: if tokenizer already defines a BOS token, strip '<|startoftext|>' from template.

Samir Gupta: I can add a normalizer in model-agent pre-serve to avoid duplicating special tokens. Pseudocode:

```bash
# in model-agent startup
if tokenizer.bos_token and prompt.startswith('<|startoftext|>'):
  prompt = prompt.replace('<|startoftext|>', '', 1)
```

Ops Bot: deploy-check report: artifact s3://redwood-models/gptx-mini/2026-03-14/model.tar.gz size=1.2GB checksum=ok. CI lint: FAILED - tokenizer mismatch (bos_token_id != model.config.bos_token_id). See build #4823 for logs.

Alex Chen: Assigning @Samir to follow up on CI fixer and add the normalization. @Mira can you update the onboarding doc with the weights path and the note about HF tokenizer id mismatch + example test cases?

Mira Patel: :thumbsup: will do. I'll add a small unit test that asserts encode/decodes preserve ids and a note about not duplicating start tokens in chat templates.

Jin Lee: One more ops note — recommend routing this model to a dedicated low-latency pool for the first week to avoid tail-latency from tiny-batch inference. Quantization profile looks fine.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a PR for the CI lint and a short playbook entry for oncall steps if this flares. :rocket:
